title: Time Reversal Wave Function
description: Essential Criteria: The time reversed form of the wave function must be correctly derived as psi^*(-t).

title: Hamiltonian for Free Electron
description: Essential Criteria: The Hamiltonian for a free electron in a magnetic field must be correctly expressed as H = (e hbar / 2mc) sigma_z H_z.

title: Time Rate of Change
description: Essential Criteria: The operator for the time rate of change of mu must be derived as dmu/dt = (e/mc) H x mu.

title: Correct Use of Operators
description: Important Criteria: The use of quantum mechanical operators and their commutation relations must be correctly applied in the derivation.

title: Time Reversal Covariance
description: Important Criteria: The condition for the Hamiltonian to be covariant under time reversal must be correctly stated.

title: Magnetic Field Components
description: Optional Criteria: The contributions of the magnetic field components in the Hamiltonian should be clearly identified.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Common sign mistakes in the expressions for the Hamiltonian or time rate of change must be avoided.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: Units must be consistent throughout the derivation, particularly in the Hamiltonian and time rate of change.
